title: Exact integral restriction charts and their pullback square
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\pi$, and $A_n=R/\pi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $h:W\to X$ be a morphism of Noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; Noetherian means a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings, and finite-dimensional means a finite bound on lengths of chains of irreducible closed subsets. For every scheme $T$ occurring below put $B_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete integral constructible category $D^b_c(T,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and its specified reduction-tower pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]; for every morphism $g$ between schemes occurring below, in particular the chart projections $g_{\alpha t}$, $Lg^*$ denotes the same derived-limit construction on all of $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},R)$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].

For every $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ there is a finite stratification $i_\alpha:S_\alpha\to X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification], pro-etale covers $v_{\alpha t}:V_{\alpha t}\to S_\alpha$, and bounded finite-projective $R$-complexes $P_{\alpha t}^\bullet$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] with
$$v_{\alpha t}^{-1}i_\alpha^{-1}K\cong B_{V_{\alpha t}}\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{P_{\alpha t}^\bullet}.$$
Here the inverse images are ordinary exact inverse images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] of modules over the corresponding completed ring sheaves. They agree naturally, including finite reductions, with the specified integral pullbacks. For each stratum immersion and each site-object cover map, inverse image identifies the completed ring sheaf with that on the source, preserves countable products and the coefficient limit, and commutes with the strict-tower Roos derived-limit model. In particular the displayed restriction commutes with every cohomology sheaf $\mathcal H^j$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]; if $\mathcal H^j(K)=0$ outside $[a,b]$, the displayed scalar model has the same bound.

Put $S'_\alpha=W\times_X S_\alpha$, $V'_{\alpha t}=W\times_X V_{\alpha t}$, and let $i'_\alpha,v'_{\alpha t},g_{\alpha t}:V'_{\alpha t}\to V_{\alpha t}$ be their projection maps. The nonempty $S'_\alpha$ form a finite constructible locally closed stratification of $W$, and $v'_{\alpha t}$ are pro-etale covers. The same exact restriction assertions hold for $i'_\alpha,v'_{\alpha t}$. There is a natural comparison
$$v_{\alpha t}'^{-1}i_\alpha'^{-1}Lh^*K\cong Lg_{\alpha t}^*(v_{\alpha t}^{-1}i_\alpha^{-1}K),$$
whose reductions are the finite-coefficient composition comparisons for the two factorizations of $V'_{\alpha t}\to X$. Empty strata impose no condition. Finally $Lh^*K$ is integral constructible, and this $R$-linear pullback preserves shifts and distinguished triangles, with the shift comparison obtained from the strict-tower completed pullback through its canonical comparison with the specified integral pullback.
